articles.body:
[q="szhveronika"]Crisis describes only situations when elephant points from one region to another. What to do if elephant is in the middle of a region?[/q]
The only time an elephant is in the middle of a region, is if the region is company controlled. If a crisis event happens in that instance, then it would be a rebellion. If ever Imperial Ambitions were triggered on the capital of a sovereign region and all adjacent regions are controlled by that capital, then the elephant would point inward from the region noted. This would signify a possible rebellion in future events.
